chunks: Yunus, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whenever the Month of Ramadan arrives, say:

O Allah! The Month of Ramadan has arrived, and You have made its fasting obligatory upon us, and You revealed the Quran in it as a guidance for the people and clear signs of guidance and the Criterion.
O Allah! Help us in fasting it. O Allah! Accept it from us, keep us safe in it, and receive it back from us in ease from You and good health.
for You are All-Powerful over everything, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

key_terms.الْفُرْقَان: Al-Furqan — a Quranic name for the Quran meaning 'the Criterion' that distinguishes truth from falsehood (Quran 2:185)
key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: The Month of Ramadan — the ninth month of the Islamic calendar, sacred for its obligatory fasting and the revelation of the Quran
key_terms.صِيَام: Sawm/fasting — the obligatory abstention from food, drink, and other things from dawn to sunset during Ramadan
key_terms.عَافِيَة: 'Afiya — wellbeing, health, and safety from affliction; a comprehensive term for divine protection

ai.seo_question: What supplication did Imam al-Sadiq teach for the arrival of Ramadan?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches a supplication to be recited upon the arrival of the month of Ramadan. The prayer acknowledges the divine obligations of the month — its obligatory fasting and the revelation of the Quran — and petitions God for help in fasting, acceptance of the worship, safety during the month, and ease in completing it. This supplication would be understood by Shia Muslims as reinforcing the sanctity of Ramadan as a time of both obligation and divine gift.
word_analysis: and the Criterion (distinguishing truth from falsehood)

en.hubeali: Yunus, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullahasws having said:
‘Whenever a Month of Ramazan presents itself, so say, ‘

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! A Month of Ramazan has presented itself, and its Fasts are Obligated upon us, and the Quran was Revealed therein, a Guidance for the people, and Clarifications of the Guidance and the Criterion.
O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Aid us upon its Fasts. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Accept it from us, and Secure us therein, and Receive it back from us in Ease from You<sup>azwj</sup>, and good health,
for You<sup>azwj</sup> are Able upon everything, O most Merciful of the merciful ones!’
en.sarwar: 6. Yunus has narrated from Ali ibn abu Hamzah, from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the month of Ramadan begins, say this, ‘O Allah, the month of Ramadan has begun and You have made it obligatory upon us to fast during this month. You have revealed Your book in it as guidance for people, as the most clear guidance and means of discernment (between right and wrong).
O Allah, help us to fast during this month. O Allah, accept it from us, grant us protection therein, receive it back from us with ease and good health.
You have power over all things, O most Merciful, most Beneficent.’”
